source.title: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Alcohol Reference, Mild Fantasy ViolenceGamesONE PIECE: Grand GourmetVersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalAlcohol Reference, Mild Fantasy ViolenceLoadingSeason the SeasONE PIECE comes to life as a restaurant management sim game!As a new staff member, work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to turn the second location of the renowned Baratie floating restaurant into the greatest restaurant of the seas!Dish Out a Signature MenuGet inspired by characters' ideas, choose your ingredients, and work with Sanji to cook delicious dishes. Arrange them into unique meal sets by adding different flourishes, then adventure to find even more recipes! From iconic series favorites like Water-Water Meat BBQ and Sea King Penne Gorgonzola to special creations that harness the powers of Devil Fruits, a treasure trove of dishes awaits.Design A Tasteful InteriorChoose from over 200 furniture, building, and decorative items to make your restaurant uniquely yours! From dessert-themed Whole Cake Island pieces to futuristic Egghead items, the customization options are as vast as the sea. If a character likes your design, they may even become a regular!Table for 400From the Straw Hat Crew and beyond, over 400 ONE PIECE characters appear as staff and customers in a spritely pixel style for the first time in a game! With so many characters, you'll experience character events and special character interactions that can’t be found anywhere else.Software description provided by the publisher.Explore this game's official websiteRelated tagsSimulationPixel artPlay for a high scoreShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)292 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. Learn moreSystemNintendo Switch 2PublisherBandai Namco EntertainmentSupported languagesJapanese, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Latin American Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Traditional Chinese, American English, ThaiRelease dateOctober 23, 2026ESRB ratingAlcohol Reference, Mild Fantasy ViolenceAbout Supported FeaturesThis software supports the following features and accessories:- Touch ScreenWARNING: If you have epilepsy or have had seizures or other unusual reactions to flashing lights or patterns, consult a doctor before playing video games. All users should read the Health and Safety Information available in the system settings before using this software.

source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for October 19 to 23
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor October 16, 2026 · 9 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 Activision Publishing Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $69.99 Pre-order Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 – October 23XBOX Play Anywhere Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory, where consequence and escalation bring long-running storylines to a powerful and emotional breaking point. Pre-order Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 today to gain Early Access to the game’s Campaign starting Friday, October 16 ahead of its global launch on October 23. FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD. ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $49.99 Pre-order Final Fantasy Resonance – October 22XBOX Play Anywhere What if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive. A classic RPG adventure unfolds in a world filled with beloved FINAL FANTASY elements—airships, crystals, espers and moogles woven into the fabric of the story, and so much more. Shoresy: Legends of the North Treewood Games, New Metric Media ☆☆☆☆☆ 3 ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now Shoresy: Legends of the North – October 19 Shoresy: Legends of the North is a fast-paced hockey RPG set in the Shoresy universe. Create your skater and join the Sudbury Blueberry Bulldogs on a quest to save the world from the legendary Hockey Godz, or go head-to-head with friends with a roster of fan-favourite characters. Candlemates (Xbox Series) Afil Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $4.99 $3.99 Get it now Candlemates – October 20 Get ready for a bright adventure full of strategy in Candlemates! Control two enchanted candles and push the fire stones onto their matching braziers, but be careful: each candle has a limited number of moves, and every step can make all the difference! Christmas Across America Collector's Edition Ocean Media LLC ☆☆☆☆☆ 2 ★★★★★ $6.99 Get it now Christmas Across America Collector’s Edition – October 20 Immerse yourself in the holiday spirit! Journey into the heart of winter America to create traditions, find hidden treasures, and experience the magic of the coziest time of year. Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey Collector's Edition Ocean Media LLC ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $9.99 Get it now Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey Collector’s Edition – October 20 Feel the sea breeze and the endless horizon! This is the beginning of a grand journey. For the first time, you step aboard a luxurious liner to spend an unforgettable honeymoon! In Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey, warm encounters and cozy evenings await, as your route takes you through the colorful islands of the Pacific Ocean. This isn’t just a sightseeing tour, it’s a celebration of life, where every day brings new emotions. Elite Sports Gaming Football Elite Sports Gaming LLC ☆☆☆☆☆ 27 ★★★★★ Get it now Elite Sports Gaming Football – October 20 ESG Football 27 is bigger, faster, and more connected than ever. Build your player, compete with friends, and experience football your way with brand-new 11v11 Rec Mode, cross-play between PlayStation and Xbox, improved matchmaking and connectivity, tutorials to learn the fundamentals, nostalgia-inspired mini-games, and a deeper player progression system with grindable badges and boosts to increase your character’s attributes. Whether you’re playing Head-to-Head, teaming up in 11v11, or grinding to build your player, ESG Football 27 brings the ultimate football experience to life. Family Journey: Hidden Across The World Collector's Edition Ocean Media LLC ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $6.99 Get it now Family Journey: Hidden Across The World Collector’s Edition – October 20 Pack your bags and join a loving family on a heartwarming journey around the world! Sharpen your eye for detail across 60 beautifully crafted hidden object scenes, each inspired by real-world cities and iconic landmarks. Take a break from searching with 12 delightful mini games and brain teasing puzzles that the whole family can enjoy together. This Collector’s Edition is packed with exclusive extras, enjoy bonus levels, a music player and achievements to keep the adventure alive. Personalize your experience in a special interior scene where you can buy furniture, and test your skills to unlock 10 unique achievements. Hail to the Rainbow Sometimes You ☆☆☆☆☆ 2 ★★★★★ $14.99 $11.99 Get it now Free Trial Hail to the Rainbow – October 20Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Hail to the Rainbow is a first-person, story-driven adventure with horror and shooter elements. Set in a richly detailed world, the game challenges you to survive in a new reality, uncover the secrets behind the surrounding chaos, and experience the protagonist’s memories and inner struggles. We Were Here Tomorrow Total Mayhem Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 4 ★★★★★ $19.99 $17.99 Get it now We Were Here Tomorrow – October 20 On an expedition to save your fellow Explorers, you and your partner become trapped beneath the ice of Antarctica. When you awaken, you find yourselves inside the mysterious Norček Industries facility with little recollection of what happened. Director Kathleen Bowe needs your help to continue the work of her missing research team before a global crisis unfolds. CyberBot: Zero (Xbox Series) GameDi Studio ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $4.99 Get it now CyberBot: Zero – October 21 In this thrilling 2D platformer, you play as CyberBot, a brave autonomous unit that must navigate a corrupted mega-facility.
